headline: Edison International (NYSE:EIX) Posting EPS Beat as Revenue Falls Short in Q2
summary: Edison International Q2 earnings beat estimates with $1.54 core EPS, but revenue fell short at $4.36B. Full-year 2026 guidance reaffirmed at $5.90-$6.20 core EPS.
